description: Golden applicability predicates (HLD v2 §4.4). Each case is an L2 obligation (jurisdiction + the structured subject / condition L2 produced, or the duty sentence when L2 has not split it) and the set of applies_to predicates L4 must derive, in the shared predicate language ({attribute: value | [any-of] | '*' | bool}). Precision and recall are computed over predicates across all cases; gate >= 0.95 each. Values are ontology names from curated/l4_ontology.json.

obligation.subject: A firm
obligation.statement: A firm that holds client money must reconcile its client money records at least once every business day.

cases.note: 'A firm' names a regulated organisation without saying which authorisation: any authorisation ('*'), never an invented licence.

obligation.subject: Crypto-asset service providers providing custody and administration of crypto-assets on behalf of clients
obligation.statement: Crypto-asset service providers providing custody and administration of crypto-assets on behalf of clients shall keep a register of positions.

obligation.subject: An electronic money institution
obligation.statement: An electronic money institution must safeguard funds received in exchange for electronic money that has been issued.

obligation.subject: Financial entities
obligation.statement: Financial entities shall have in place an internal governance and control framework that ensures an effective and prudent management of ICT risk.

obligation.subject: The controller
obligation.condition: where a type of processing is likely to result in a high risk
obligation.statement: Where a type of processing is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons, the controller shall carry out a data protection impact assessment.

obligation.subject: Investment firms
obligation.condition: when marketing, distributing or selling contracts for differences to retail clients
obligation.statement: Investment firms shall not market, distribute or sell contracts for differences to retail clients without leverage limits.

obligation.subject: Each member
obligation.statement: Each member shall establish and maintain a system to supervise the activities of each associated person.

obligation.subject: Every broker or dealer
obligation.statement: Every broker or dealer shall promptly obtain and thereafter maintain the physical possession or control of all fully-paid securities and excess margin securities carried for the account of customers.

obligation.subject: A payment service provider
obligation.condition: where the framework contract is concluded at a distance through electronic means
obligation.statement: Where the framework contract is concluded at a distance, a payment service provider must provide the information in a durable medium.

cases.note: A generic duty with no subject cue narrows by jurisdiction only; inventing a licence here would be a precision failure.

obligation.statement: Records required by this chapter must be retained for at least five years.

obligation.subject: Investment firms
obligation.statement: Investment firms that appoint tied agents shall remain fully and unconditionally responsible for any action or omission of the tied agent.

cases.note: A synthetic source in an unknown jurisdiction gets no jurisdiction predicate (the ontology does not know it) but keeps subject cues.

obligation.subject: A firm
obligation.statement: A firm must appoint a money laundering reporting officer.

expected_obligations.note: Evaluated only when the listed obligations are present in the store (source keys from the L1 registry).
